name: Fruit color
description: Reported fruit color or color intensity of a variety. A real, generic gap in the original blueberry-derived trait vocabulary: found while adding Cornell's raspberry release Crimson Treasure, whose own coverage (Fruit Growers News) describes 'vibrant colors' as a stated selling point alongside yield and flavor, with no existing trait entity to record it against. Applicable across all four berries (color variation is real and commercially relevant in each: blush/gold raspberries and blackberries, white/pink strawberries, powder-blue vs. near-black blueberries), not raspberry-specific.
